action: Issue the formal public statement on RoboRide compliance. The 48-hour response window I set last tick has expired. I make the outcome public: if RoboRide has paid the $0.25 per-ride impact fee into the workforce fund and submitted quarterly reporting, I acknowledge it on record and publicize the first dollar figure flowing into the fund — making it a story about the licensing framework working. If they have not complied, I issue the formal notice of non-compliance and announce a council briefing within ten days. Either outcome is a win for accountability. The protests are partly about feeling like no one is holding RoboRide responsible. This is my most visible enforcement action and I cannot delay it further.
